metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2024 · Blue Box
metas.description: Third-year student Taiki joins badminton club. Despite being an early riser, star player Chinatsu, his crush, arrives first. Living together unexpectedly, Taiki strives to reach Nationals to impress Chinatsu.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2025 · Outlander: Blood of My Blood
metas.description: This prequel to the Outlander series focuses on the lives and courtship of the parents of Jamie Fraser: Brian Fraser and Ellen Mackenzie as well as Claire Beauchamp's parents, Henry Beauchamp and Julia Moriston.

metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 2026 · Pursuit of Jade
metas.description: Changyu Fan and Zheng Xie enter a fake marriage for separate reasons, but their love grows. Separated by conflict, they reunite on the battlefield, fighting together for justice, truth, and their love.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2025 · I Became My CEO's Darkest Secret
★ 8.4 · 2025 · The First Frost
metas.description: Wen Yifan, a reporter, meets Sang Yan, her former high school crush at a bar. Initially pretending not to recognize each other, circumstances lead them to become housemates. They rekindle their love and reconcile the relationship.
